visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young man with brown hair and glasses, wearing a black T-shirt, stands in an outdoor parking lot with trees and buildings in the background, speaking animatedly to the camera. (2) He enters a small office with wood-paneled walls; a woman with long dark hair sits at a desk with a computer and various papers. (3) The scene shifts to an outdoor car dealership called 'ATZU DREAM CAR', where the man and woman walk past several grey and white Toyota Altis cars; he points at the engine components under an open hood. (4) Close-up shots of car engines are shown as the man explains conditions like dust and maintenance while the woman holds a blue box of keys. (5) They move to a white Honda Fit and then a white Mazda 3, inspecting the interior door panels and opening the hoods while laughing and gesturing toward the camera.
